skills.name: business-report-writing
skills.description: Write concise business reports or executive summaries from analytical evidence, choosing useful presentation and measurable proposed actions without a fixed template.

skills.name: customer-retention
skills.description: Analyze acquisition cohorts, repeat purchasing, retention, churn or inactivity. Use when customer history, time eligibility or cohort denominators determine the answer.

skills.name: period-comparison
skills.description: Compare revenue or other metrics across months, quarters or other periods, including partial periods, percentage changes and zero baselines.

skills.name: product-ranking-analysis
skills.description: Compare product rankings, top-N selections, customer reach, ranking overlap and boundary ties. Use for interpreting leaders or follow-ups about products in earlier lists.

skills.name: revenue-driver-analysis
skills.description: Investigate why revenue differs or changes, including prices, quantities, customers, order patterns and revenue concentration. Use when an explanation needs more than ranking membership.

skills.name: analytical-review
skills.description: Review analytical answers for requested coverage, supported interpretations, metric validity, useful presentation and authorized operations. Supplied to the evaluator on every review.
